43
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, August 10, 2011/Sravana 19, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Defence; Home Affairs;
Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Labour and Employment;
Textiles; Urban Development)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Funds allocated under JNNURM in
Bihar
†*141. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cities in Bihar where
projects under Jawaharlal Nehru Urban
Renewal Mission (JNNURM) are
proposed to be undertaken and the amount
allocated for these projects;
(b) the project-wise plans for
implementation of these projects and the
status of their progress;
(c) whether it is a fact that this ambitious
scheme of Government is getting entangled
in the net of redtapism as the process of
preparing the projects and approving them
is very complex; and
(d) if so, the measures proposed to be
taken to expedite the implementation of
the projects taken up under JNNURM?
Bringing Delhi Police under the
control of Delhi Government
†*142. SHRI PARVEZ HASHMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal is under
consideration with regard to bringing Delhi
Police under the control of Delhi
Government;
(b) if so, the view of the Ministry on
this proposal;
(c) whether it is a fact that every State
has its own police force which makes the
States responsible to maintain law and
order; and
(d) the details of the measures being
taken regarding the deteriorating condition
of law and order in Delhi?

44
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Allowing FDI in retail sector
*143. SHRIMATI GUNDU SUDHA-
RANI: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the proposal under consideration of
Government for allowing Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI) in retail sector;
(b) whether any assessment or study has
been conducted by Government about its
impact on the local small shopkeepers; and
(c) the basis of the Ministry’s
contention that allowing FDI in retail  sector
would generate more jobs and reduce food
inflation?
Equipping Indian Navy with 'Kawach'
*144. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
equip Indian Navy with "Kawach" which
has target hitting range of 45 km;
(b) whether test fires for "Kawach"
have already taken place;
(c) if so, by when it is likely to be
inducted in Indian Navy; and
(d) the details thereof?
Pakistani nationals jailed for terrorist
activities
*145. SHRI Y . S. CHOWDARY: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of Pakistani nationals who
have been jailed for terrorist activities across
the country;
(b) the details of expenditure incurred
on their security or otherwise;
(c) the details of Pakistani nationals
awarded capital punishment; and
(d) the number of persons hanged/
awarded death penalty till date?
Police atrocities in States
†*146. SHRI KAPTAN SINGH
SOLANKI: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the cases of
police atrocities are on a rise throughout
the country, including Delhi and UP, during
the last three years;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof;
(c) the details of complaints received
against police during the last three years,
State-wise; and
(d) the action taken by Government in
this regard, State-wise?
Revival of textile units in Tirupur,
Tamil Nadu
*147. SHRI T.M. SELVAGANA-
PATHI: Will the Minister of TEXTILES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had decided to set up a group to work for
revival of the affected textile units in
Tirupur in Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that more
than 1,000 textile units in Tirupur have
been closed; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
re-open these units?
Production of iodized salt in Gujarat
*148. SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Gujarat is the largest
producer of salt in the country;

45
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the logic behind the Salt
Commissioner's Office being located in
Jaipur;
(c) how much iodized salt is produced
in Gujarat vis-a-vis other States of India;
(d) the State-wise details of the
consumption percentage of iodized salt;
(e) how many States distribute the
iodized salt through PDS enabling its reach
to the poor people; and
(f) whether iodized salt distributed
through PDS has lower price compared to
the one sold in open market?

Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has achieved
the target for creation of housing and
infrastructural facilities under provisioning
of basic services to urban poor and
